State legend

default
Resting state, no interaction.
[data-demo-hover]
Pins the :hover face for screenshots (brighter face + label shift, ≥5% pixel delta).
[data-demo-active]
Pins the pressed face (1px nudge / darken).
:focus-visible
Token focus ring (Tab to any control) — never suppressed.
[disabled]
Dim face + disabled text, no hover/active, skipped or aria-disabled.
status glyphs
info=droplet, success=stitch-check, warn=fray-knot triangle, error=frayed-X — color is never the only cue.
selection
Luminance-edge frame (knotlight/muslin outline), survives all three colorblind projections.

Core Surfaces

tabs modal tooltip toast progress

Tabs

Modal

All demos use the static attribute so the dialog renders in-flow for screenshots. Live modals are fixed over a screen-dim backdrop, trap Tab, close on Escape (cancelable lf-close), and return focus to the invoker.

Tooltip

Dark loom-room card in both themes. Shows on hover AND keyboard focus (never hover-only); Escape dismisses. Demos below use the open attribute to pin the bubble for screenshots.

Toast

Every status pairs its color with a required glyph — info=droplet, success=stitch-check, warn=fray-knot triangle, error=frayed-X — plus a colored left hem (position cue). Live toasts spawn via <lf-toast-rack>.show(): fixed top-right, max 3 visible, ~5s auto-dismiss paused on hover/focus. Demos are sticky (no duration).

Progress

Game HUD

hotbar inventory statbars crosshair chat

Hotbar

9-slot toolbar. Selection = stitched knotlight border + notch marker (luminance + shape, survives all colorblind projections). Number keys 1–9, arrows, wheel and click all select. Tab into the bar to see the focus ring on a slot.

Item slot & Inventory grid

Drag a stack between cells (ghost icon follows the pointer), or use keyboard: arrows move, Enter picks up / places, Esc cancels. Hovering or focusing a filled cell shows the tooltip card (dark loom-room card in both themes).

Statbars

Health (kite shard), armor (loom-shield), hunger (drumstick) — each stat has its own silhouette, so rows never rely on hue alone. One pip = 2 points; odd values fill the left half. A screen-reader status region reads "Health 14 of 20. Armor 8 of 20. Hunger 16 of 20."

Crosshair

Five pure-SVG variants, muslin stroke with mix-blend-mode: difference so the reticle inverts against any world pixel (shown here on light and dark ramp swatches). Decorative only: aria-hidden, never focusable; the shell hides it while a GUI is open ([hidden]) and centers it in game mode ([fixed]).

Chat

Scrollback log (role="log", polite live region) + input row while [open]. System lines carry three cues: knot glyph, italics, info color. Enter sends (lf-send), Esc while typing blurs the input first; Esc again closes (lf-close). 256-char limit, 50-line scrollback.

Shells & Menus

debug-overlay pause-menu main-menu world-select settings-shell

Debug overlay

F3-style two-column monospace readout on translucent void-ink strips (aria-hidden — a developer readout, not an interactive surface). All demos use static to render in-flow; live overlays pin to the viewport's top-left at the HUD z-layer. Values are seeded from data-* attributes; at runtime the host calls setData().

Pause menu

Centered stack over the screen-dim backdrop; the world keeps rendering behind it (the demo's static mode paints a warpwold-ramp stand-in). Escape emits lf-back (pops exactly one level); every button emits lf-action. Tab to any button to see the token focus ring.

Main menu

Title screen: brand wordmark (saved asset, token-recolored) over the woven duskwarp backdrop, splash line, button column, Accessibility icon entry point, version corner. Brand-anchored loom-room night in BOTH themes. Buttons emit lf-action (singleplayer / multiplayer / settings / quit / accessibility).

World select

Listbox of world cards. Selection = 2px knotlight LUMINANCE frame (survives all three colorblind sims — never a hue-only recolor). Keyboard: Up/Down move + select, Enter plays, E edits, Delete opens the destructive-confirm modal (explicit Cancel — no dead ends), Escape / Back emits lf-back. Right/Left rove within the focused card — card → Play → Edit → Delete (Enter/Space activates, Escape returns to the card) — while the card stays the list's only Tab stop. Double-click a card to play; the action row is revealed on hover, selection, or focus. Cards are role="option" only inside the listbox; standalone cards expose role="group" named by the world.

Settings shell

Left category rail (vertical tablist: arrows rove, Enter/Space activates; selected tab = 2px gold edge marker + heading color — never color alone) + content pane that authored panels dock into. Composes builder A's lf-slider / lf-toggle / lf-dropdown. Done (primary CTA) and Escape emit lf-back — pops exactly one level back to whichever screen pushed Settings.

Loomfall — Light Through the Warp. Colors are generated from brand/palette.json; components use var(--lf-*) tokens only. Toggle the theme above to verify both modes.
